newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures slice gains again.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures slice gains again.

text.p: July 23 - U.S. stock index futures sliced gains again, still higher. Sept S&P 500s edged downward as T-bond futures whittled gains despite decent demand at five-year note sale. Some S&P pundits looked for futures to range-trade until T-bonds close, then possibly retest lows before closing nearly volatile session nearly flat.
